description: This Kotlin source file implements a PhotosHandler class responsible for fetching and encoding photos from the device's media store in an Android application. It includes data classes for request parameters and payloads, a data source interface with an implementation that interacts with Android's MediaStore, permission checking, image decoding, scaling, and JPEG encoding under size constraints. The PhotosHandler handles incoming JSON requests to retrieve limited photo data, returning a JSON payload with encoded images.
